protocol.cpu: Native/unrolled -O3 single-threaded C++; generic exact kernels for control/atlas/interpolation, shared-plane fixed-field recurrence kernel for chains; compact host inputs, result bytes and exact comparison timed
protocol.native-host: Fresh native PCM serialization of compact host inputs; exact prefix check, input decode, prediction, completion fence, selected full-I420 host readback and exact comparison timed
protocol.prepared-host: Prepared compressed input access units still decoded each request; prediction, fence, selected full-I420 host readback and exact comparison timed
protocol.prepared-complete: Unequal-interface diagnostic omitting host work: prepared compressed inputs still submitted and decoded, all real pictures awaited, zero returned host results. No readback, output pixel checks, GPU consumer, surface retention or surface handoff in timed requests. Not an application-throughput win
protocol.validation: All four fixtures and every real I420 picture checked before timing in every layout. Every completion-only trial is followed by four NEW full-I420 decode/check requests outside timing; those checks do not observe pixels of preceding completion-only requests
protocol.excluded: Source/artifact loading, allocation of reusable CPU scratch and PCM templates, decoder setup, one warmup, completion-only postflight and final fence drain/close; lifecycle times reported
protocol.ordering: Five rotated repeats by default; four changing fixtures per trial; CPU measured once per workload per repeat, each decoder interface per layout
protocol.accounting: Parent plus live helper process CPU, including their threads; excludes IRQs, kernel workqueues, other processes. No energy/power inference
protocol.scope: Same-host implementation and interface sensitivity, warm caches and static motion fields; no universal CPU optimality or direct GPU-surface import claim
